assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are maintainer-defined provisional geometry.
assumptions.impact: All spatial metrics, drawings and visual emphasis are intake-level and must be recalculated after official polygons arrive.
assumptions.mitigation: Replace all boundary-dependent layers and rerun every gate when an official or cleared file is supplied.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, coverage, green controls, setbacks, road redlines and facility controls are not in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Intensity and form are expressed as directional design logic only; no statutory numeric control is claimed.
assumptions.mitigation: Import the official regulatory-plan conditions and reconcile land use, buildings, roads and metrics.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, uses, floors, age and condition are not available as cleared spatial data.
assumptions.impact: Building features are conceptual reference footprints, not an existing survey or demolition decision.
assumptions.mitigation: Replace or calibrate the building layer against an official or cleared survey.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, station geometry, parking supply and traffic counts are not available.
assumptions.impact: Roads express walking, cycling and connection logic only.
assumptions.mitigation: Run a transport and accessibility review before any project-level conclusion.

assumptions.statement: Parcel boundaries, ownership and rights-holder consent are not available.
assumptions.impact: Renewal items remain conceptual and cannot assign a parcel-level DRR outcome.
assumptions.mitigation: Obtain cleared cadastral/rights data and conduct participation before selecting projects.

assumptions.statement: Official heritage protection and construction-control limits are not available.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks and public components remain restrained concept directions.
assumptions.mitigation: Check official protection planning and invite heritage professionals before design development.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, fire access, flood control, drainage and energy conditions are not available.
assumptions.impact: New infrastructure is an adaptable service-layer recommendation, not a capacity or feasibility calculation.
assumptions.mitigation: Run municipal, safety, ecological and energy studies before implementation decisions.

assumptions.statement: Scenario cards use only public, aggregate, authorized or voluntary data and avoid identity tracking.
assumptions.impact: Some operational performance metrics remain unmeasured and are shown as pending.
assumptions.mitigation: Define a data charter, retention rules, complaint path and human-review protocol with operators.

assumptions.statement: Operating roles, maintenance budgets, event permissions and funding are not determined.
assumptions.impact: Phasing and project items are recommendations rather than commitments.
assumptions.mitigation: Use a documented co-creation and rights/operations agreement before launch.
